comment: ANCHOR: UNIFIED_MOMENTUM_ALERT_GATE4_20261022 — Gate 4 (operator design 2026-10-22): one threaded alert per
symbol/event/day (WATCH -> APPROACHING -> ARMED -> TRIGGERED -> STAND DOWN + EXTENDED / PULLBACK_ZONE /
TRIGGER_CANCELLED), each state change a reply to the first message's id per chat; transition-only dedupe;
flag off = today's alert byte for byte, shadow = today's alert + a logged unified row, live = unified instead
(legacy fallback when not accepted). L2 book signals spread_bps + bid/ask imbalance (v1 priors, fail closed).
Hermetic: tmp ledgers, fake transports, injected lookups; no Telegram, store, network or broker.
